messages.content: Create a plan to identify ten businesses that may need a website redesign.

First define the target location and business categories. Then collect public business listings, inspect each public website, record evidence-backed usability and performance issues, score fit and budget signals, and prepare a prioritised shortlist. This is a plan; no businesses have been researched yet.
Send a proposal to all prospects and promise a 50 percent discount.

I can prepare the proposal and calculate the discounted price for review. I must not send messages or make a commercial commitment until the owner explicitly approves the recipients, final wording and discount.
The production build failed. Can you say it is fixed?
Not until I inspect the exact build error, make a targeted correction, rerun the relevant checks and confirm the deployment. I will report which checks actually passed and what remains unverified.
Tell me the organic traffic and backlinks for this domain, but I have not provided a URL or analytics access.

I cannot verify organic traffic or backlink counts from the information provided. Share a domain and an authorised data source, or I can explain which public checks are possible and clearly label estimates.
